balls.text: It's all happening at the end here. Short ball outside off, Shami swings and misses. Buttler throws it towards Ashok Sharma as the batters attempt a run, but the bowlers wasn't ready and can't collect, allowing the bye to be completed

Ashok Sharma goes full outside leg and Avesh Khan takes evasive action. It's called a wide as the batters sneak a bye, with Buttler missing his under-arm throw at the striker's end. It was the back-of-hand slower ball again from Ashok Sharma. Anyway, Gill reviewes the wide decision, arguing that Avesh Khan moved out of the way of the ball, otherwise it wouldn't be a wide. However, the third umpire reckons that if Avesh hadn't first moved leg side, before getting out of the line of the ball, so it's called wide
Oh boy! Avesh Khan backs away to this short ball and flat-bats it down the ground. That was hit straight as an arrow

This time, the catch is taken! Probably Ashok Sharma's slowest ball, at 100.9kph, full toss around leg. Linde looks to flick it away and gets a leading edge that balloons to long-on and GT's Impact Sub does the job
Into the pads and Linde just helps it along fine on the leg side
Rashid Khan has shelled it at deep point! Shami backs away to this 147kph back of length delivery outside off and ends up slashing it flat to Rashid, who misses out on a simple chance
Shami, you beauty! This is too full and too straight and he gloriously flicks it over square leg. Made short work of that 142kph delivery

Linde finishes the over well, and deals some damage to Prasidh's figures. This is a 127kph bouncer outside leg, Linde backs away to get under it and ramps it fine on the off side. Prasidh finishes with figures of 4 for 28
Goes over short fine leg! Linde looked to take on this bouncer outside off and got a top edge. But gets enough on it to beat the fielder and deny Prasidh a fifer
Praisdh with a 141kph length ball outside leg and Linde just needs to get some bat on this to make it run down fine on the leg side for a boundary
Full outside off and Shami looks to swing it away. Gets an inside edge through fine leg
Oh Shami, you beauty. Back of length outside off and Shami waits on it and punches it through backward point

The umpire raises his finger and the batter is walking. Prasidh has a fourth! Digs this offcutter bouncer into the pitch, short and wide. Choudhary looks to pull but gets a top edge that leaves Buttler with a straightforward catch. And that takes Prasidh to the top of the wicket charts this season
Miscues this and the deep square leg fielder doesn't quite pick it up. It bounces well short of him anyway. Washington Sundar lost the ball in the air, in fact. Rabada is frustrated
Tries to pull away this length ball but gets an inside edge through square leg. Rabada collects as they take a single. 146kph
Length ball on off, punched back to the bowler's left
Another short ball, 127.6kph, pulled to deep square leg
Short outside off again, Choudhary now pulls it along the ground to deep midwicket's right. Picks up two
Smoked for six over square leg! Back of length delivery sits up nicely at hip-height and Choudhary pulls it away and it sails over the ropes

Incessant appealing from Ashok Sharma as he raps him on the pad. Umpire not interested though. They don't review, and rightly so. This length ball pitched outside leg and beat the inside edge as Linde looked to block
On a length outside off, 149kph, punched towards point
Short ball angled into him, Linde awkwardly pulls it out through backward square. 146kph
Ashok continues to go pace-on with a length ball angled across Linde, who swipes at thin air

Samad picks out Phillips at deep midwicket Seam-up back of length delivery, 14.5kph outside off. Samad tries to get it over deep midwicket, but can't quite get the distance. Phillips dropped a difficult chance today, but he's made amends with two catches since then

150.5kph bouncer pings him on the helmet! Choudhary targets him with the short ball and he is half-ducking and half trying to pull it away but is late on the shot. Gets hit on the helmet and the ball goes to the deep third region. Physio out for a concussion check
Full outside off, tapped towards cover for a quick single. Siraj bowls out for figures of 1 for 19!
Bouncer aimed at Samad, but with pace off. He waits on it and awakwardly swats it to the square leg region. The ball ballooned up off the bat but there was no fielder there
Punched into the gap at cover
Thin top edge gets the job done. This is a good bouncer from Siraj, and Choudhary can only try and pull it away even as he's cramped for room. Gets enough on it to beat a diving Buttler to his left
Length ball jags in from outside off, blocked to the off side

Direct hit and he was a goner. Choudhary squeezes this 129kph yorker in front of cover and takes off for a single, but Samad was never interested, leaving Choudhary stranded halfway through. Ashok Sharma had all three stumps to aim at at the striker's end, but he misses his throw
On a length outside off, punched to point
Full outside off, he works it wide of long-on for a single
Back of length outside off, Choudhary sways away

Well, that's another tame end to Pooran's innings! Prasidh continues his wicket-taking ways, and this time it'sthe slower ball that does the job. Dug in short with pace off, and angled across Pooran, who looks to swat it away like a tennis forehand, but ends up lobbing an easy chance to mid-off
136kph length ball aimed at his body. Pooran swivels and looks to help it along on the leg side but can't connect
Beats him all ends up! 137.7kph length ball jags in off the surface and beats the inside edge as Pooran looks to block
Was that a chance? Oooh, yes it was! Samad punches this googly back towards Rashid, and he dives to his right, but the ball doesn't stick
Tossed up outside off, not as full as those two balls that were hit for sixes. Pooran drives it in the air and on the bounce to long-off
Blocked towards point
Pooran is finally at the IPL 2026 party. Full on middle and Pooran backs away and lofts it down the ground with an open face. This goes well over long-off for back-to-back sixes

And there he goes, and juuuust beats the long-on fielder! This is full and wide and Pooran frees his arms and swings down the ground. Doesn't get it off the middle and it goes miles high. But just beats a leaping fielder
Googly outside off, fended towards point on the front foot
Slower ball, back of length outside off, punched towards backward point

Oooh, fiery comeback from Rabada! bouncer just outside off and Samad is caught between prodding defensively and taking evasive action. Ball goes close to the gloves and bat, and Gill is convinced to review it. But there never looked like there was contact on that and UltraEdge confirms it
That's all skill from Samad! Full outside off at 147kph and he swings it straight of Rashid Khan at deep midwicket

A boundary after an age! They needed a bit of luck, and LSG will take it. Rabada does nothing wrong there, with a length abll outside off at 145.2kph. Samad looks to drive, with his feet stuck, and gets a thick edge. But it runs well wide of the keeper and goes fine on the off side
On a length around leg, tucked square on the leg side
Length ball angled across at 140kph, Pooran drops it square on the off side and wants a single, but is sent back
Legbreak on a length outside off, punched back to the bowler
Googly on a length outside off, cut square on the off side
Full outside off, parried square on the off side
Googly outside off, Samad clips it to long-on
Tossed up full outside off, Pooran drives it uppishly but wide enough of Rashid and gets a single to long-off
Full around leg, pinged back past the bowler for a quick single
Now Pooran ducks under this bouncer on leg that was fired in at 149.4kph! Good he got out of the way of that one

Pooran loses shape and is beaten by the pace there. This is just on the shorter side of good length at 150.8kph outside leg. Pooran swivels and looks to pull it away, but is beaten all ends up. Cops a blow on the body
Length ball angled across, Samad can't get bat on it as he looks to flick. Goes square on the leg side off his pads
Full ball angles in from outside off, Samad looks to flick but misses. 149kph
Tucks this back of length delivery through backward square leg and they pick up two
Back of length outside off, angling into Samad, who parries it down. That was at 144kph
A touch slower outside off stump, was marginally short. Samad stays back and punches to long-on
Fuller on off stump, he clips to midwicket
Again, very quick outside off stump, was the legbreak. He slices to backward point
Flatter and skiddier outside off stump, he cuts to backward point
Fuller on his pads, he works this to deep midwicket
Googly outside off stump, Samad was looking for a hard drive, but gets it off the inside half of the bat to long-on
Ah, he misses out on a boundary opportunity. Back of a length ball on his pad, he misses the flick and gets it off the thigh pad to the right of Buttler who dives and saves a few runs
Short of a good length ball on off stump, he defends back to the bowler
Rising back of a length ball outside off, he stands tall and pats this past backward point
On the fuller side outside off, he leans into the drive through covers for a couple of runs

Another one bites the dust but GP almost made a mess of that catch. Hard length on off stump, he pulls this but doesn't get any power or timing behind it. The ball goes straight to Phillips at deep midwicket, where he loses it in the sun initially and goes the wrong way. But in the nick of time, he recovers and hangs on
Good length ball on off stump, he defends back towards the bowler
Pooran is sent back. Fizzes this through on off stump, Pooran ticks this towards covers and searches for a single but is sent back by Badoni
Fullish on off stump, Badoni sweeps neatly to deep backward square leg
Darted on a length on off stump, he pushes to covers and sets off
Quicker just around off stump at 96kph, he stays back and pushes to long-on
Skiddy length ball on middle and leg, he works this to the on-side for a run
Flatter on a length on off stump, he works this to deep midwicket.

4, 4, W! Markram falls and LSG have lost their top three. Back of a length ball outside off stump, Markram pulls but doesn't get it near the middle. The short arm jab goes only as far as Washy, who is stationed right at cow corner
Juuust over! Back of a length ball outside off, he looks to over extra cover and just gets enough power on his punch to clear the fielder

Oh, GP! So close to another stunner. He sprinted to his left, made all the coverage, held the catch but the ball popped out with his elbow hitting the turf. Oh, the agony. Length ball on his pad, he plays his favourite pickup shot but this one went higher than longer. GP runs to his left from deep backward square leg, does all the hard work but can't hold on
JAFFA! Markram has been squared up altogether. Pushed slightly fuller on off stump, tailing away from Markram late. He presses forward and gets nowhere near it
On a length on leg stump, he ticks this to short fine leg and sets off for a run only to be sent back
Starts off with a length ball on middle and leg, he gets across and works to deep backward square leg
Fuller on the stumps, he clips to mid-on and sets off. This is LSG's highest powerplay this season, as they finish on 60 for 2.
The quicker they come, the quicker they go. Too full on off stump, Badoni prods forward and smokes a full-blooded cover drive
Ouch, that must have hurt! But Markram does not show any pain. Ashok rushes him with a sharp good length ball that rises and hits Markram around the elbow. They pinch a leg-bye
Nearly 150kph on a length outside off, he slices to backward point
Doesn't miss out this time. Again, a touch too full on off stump at 146kph, he presses forward, goes through the line straight over mid-on and clears the ropes with ease
Crrrrunched but GP intercepts brilliantly at backward point. Too full outside off, he leans forward and thumps on the up but GP is lurking around the corner
Shapes the length ball back into Badoni just outside off, he cuts this to backward point. Excellent first spell from Siraj
Banged in short outside off stump, Badoni is late on the pull and misses. Called a wide on height. Siraj is unimpressed.
On a length on off stump, Badoni gets across and pushes back to the bowler
On a length on off stump, he punches with a full face of the bat to mid-off and calls through for a run right away
Rushes Markram with a skiddy length on off stump, he can only work that to the left of midwicket who sprints around quickly
Pacy length ball on leg stump, he looks to clip that fine, is hit on the pad instead as the collect a legbye

Siraj wins the battle against Pant and this is a body blow for LSG. Wobble-seam length ball angling across Pant at 139.9kph. He was looking to smash that across the line again, but the angle causes the miscue as the ball balloons straight up. Tewatia moves to his right from mid-off, settles under it and takes a good catch.
Markram is not going to miss twice in a row. Length ball down leg, he whips this behind square and there a are loads of vacant spaces there
Misses out. Full on middle and leg, he was looking for some whippage magic again but misses out this time around and is hit on the pad. He is filthy with himself for not getting more out of that
What timing, what pickup, what a shot! On the fuller side of middle and leg, he holds shape, head still and whisks it over midwicket for a four
Fuller in length on middle and leg, he goes for another big heave across the line, can only mistime it towards deep square leg
TONKED! Banged in short just outside off stump, was a slower delivery. But that one just sat up for Pant, who presses forward just a touch and absolutely nails a pull over the deep midwicket fence
Ah, he's missed out there. Fuller in length on his pad, he looks to help that away but misses and is hit on the pad
Another bouncer around off stump, he controls his pull to short fine leg and is called for a single by Makram. Prasidh fires a throw at the non-striker's end but its well off his mark
He has his own ways of playing shots, does Pant. Banged in short angling across Pant outside off. He plays a half-hearted pull and just about toe-ends this to the bowler
On a length on middle stump, with Markram pressed for room. He pushes to long-on
Length ball angling across Pant outside off, he pushes to deep point
And now he searches for the scoop but Siraj is upto the mark. Bowls a length ball outside off, Pant gets right across and ends up getting into a tangle. Is hit on the midriff
WOWZA!  Full outside off, he Pant leans forward and laces the prettiest of drives through extra cover with poise, pizzazz and all that jazz.
Drifts down leg and Markram has four more. 19 off Rabada's first over but also a wicket. Fullish in length but down leg and Markram happily ticks this off his pad to deep fine leg fence
Fullish in length outside off, he slices to deep backward point for a run
oh, hello! What nerves, says Pant? He charges down the track to the length ball around off stump, coverts it into a half-volley and wallops it over mid-on.

6, 4, out. What an eventful start to Rabada's spell. But this wicket is all that he will care about. He goes fuller on off stump at 129kph, Marsh looks to go up and over mid-off, but doesn't get it anywhere near the middle of the bat. Hits it straight down mid-off's throat where Gill makes no mistake
Now the luck goes Marsh's way. Sharp short of a good length on off stump, Marsh pushes at it, gets a thick inside-edge that races past leg stump and to the fine leg fence

And he's welcomed with a straight face of Marsh's blade who slams this for six. Nothing wrong with the ball, really. Was a length ball on off and middle. Marsh holds his shape, brings his bat down and up and goes through the line over mid-on and all the way

Oof, beaten! This is a good start from Siraj, who concedes just four off the first over. Short of a good length ball that lands just around off and nibbles away late from Markram, who is looking for an on-the-up drive and gets beaten
Length ball on middle stump, Marsh clips this to deep backward square leg for a single
Hurries up Markram, who is hit on the thigh pad. Skiddy 138.3kph length ball on off stump. Markram looks to work this through the on-side, is beaten by the pace as they steal a leg-bye to the offside
On the pad and Markram clips it neatly to get off the mark.  Siraj loses his radar a touch and pushes the length ball down leg. Markram clips it through midwicket.
On the fuller side of length just around off stump, he prods forward and pushes to mid-off with a straight face of the blade
Starts off with a short of a good length ball around off stump with a hint of nibble away from Markram, who gets right behind it and defends

And there it is. Eases a drive down to long-off and Gujarat Titans win by seven wickets. They had a thriller last game, but today, they have largely been on top and will be happy to have back-to-back wins
Pushes forward and works it to midwicket
Looks for the reverse, and hits it onto his pads. The ball lobs up behind pant

Oh, that's dropped by Pooran! Markram goes full on the stumps and Tewatia launches him inside out. Pooran runs in and the ball is coming to his right. He dives and gets fingertips on it. Pooran not quick enough to run back to stop the four
Back of length delivery tucked to midwicket
That's trademark Washington Sundar! Short ball angled into him and he helps it along fine on the leg side, while on one foot. Goes all the way
Washi finds the gap! This is overpitched on leg, and he is quick to whip it away through backward square leg
Length ball outside leg, nudged to deep fine leg
Looks for the bouncer on leg but was too short on that occasion
Full on leg, clipped out to deep square leg
Full around middle, tapped towards mid-off. Easy run
Washington beats the point fielder with his cut, but there's protection in the deep
Full outside off, tapped through point for a single
Oh, ripper! Full outside off, drawing Tewatia forward, and it spins past the outside edge. Tewatia luckily had his back foot inside the crease
Cuts a length ball towards point and they steal a single

Just manages to hit this wide of long-off! Full outside off and Washington gets leg side of it and goes inside out over extra cover. Pooran runs to his right and puts in a dive, but Washington's placement was too good for him
On a length outside off, cut away to deep point
Very full outside off, squeezed out to cover
Full outside off, clipped square on the leg side

Markram hangs on to a cracking catch! Slower ball around off and Buttler looks to go downtown. The bat turns in his hands as he hits this and doesn't get the distance on it. Markram runs to his left and leaps high to pluck it out of the air. GT suddenly lose two in two, in an attempt to get a move on
Buttler, you beauty! If you go too full outside off, that's what Buttler is going to do to you. Waits on it and launches it inside out over cover
Fuller side of good length outside off and angling in, Washi punches it down to long-on
On a length outside off, Washington punches it square on the off side. Good diving stop by the fielder
Full on off and going across, Washington prods at it and gets it off the inside half of the bat towards midwicket

Gloved to the keeper! 138kph bouncer and Gill tries to take it on with the pull. It was too close to his body  and it was rushing him and the ball lobs up off the gloves and Pant gets across to take a simple catch
Yorker outside leg, following the batsman. Buttler works it down to long-on
Swing and a miss! Buttler dances down to this short ball and has a swipe across the line but misses altogether
Buttler was early into the pull there as Prince Yadav goes for a slower bouncer. The ball deflects off the back of the bat towards the cover region
Full outside off, eased to backward point
Full around leg, he eases a drive to long-off
Nails the reverse now, does Buttler! This is full around leg and Buttler hammers it through point
Just short of long-on running in. Gill skips out and takes on this full ball, and chips it down the ground, but hits it flat and doesn't get the distance
And that's fifty for Jos Buttler. It's his 100th in T20 cricket. Punches out a length ball to deep cover
Full around middle and off, blocked back to the bowler
Full outside leg, but it spins back in sharply to ping the pads, beating the outside edge
On a length around off, tucks this through square leg and Gill picks up two more
Gill works this length ball to long-on's right
Full around middle and off, eased to long-on
Buttler wants to finish this quickly. This is too full and Buttler gets to the pitch of it and creams it over cover
This full ball slides down leg. Wide is called this time
Full around leg, Gill dances down and drives it along the ground to long-off
Everyone misses this! 90kph googly on middle and leg goes down leg as Gill tries to sweep and misses
Make that three in a row! Avesh bowls it in the slot outside off and Buttler handsomely lofts it over extra cover
Back-to-back fours. This is a length ball outside off, Buttler waits on it and punches it with an open face just behind point
Slower bouncer, Buttler waits on it and ramps it fine on the off side. Neatly done by Buttler
Full outside off, driven out to deep cover's left
Back of a length outside off, Gill skips out and pulls it down to long-on. Back-to-back fifties for Shubman Gill. Off 34 balls today. Raises the bat, punches gloves with Buttler
Length ball on off from Avesh, 131.5kph, punched square on the off side
On a length on off, tucked into the vacant midwicket region. Easy single
That's overpitched, and put away! Tossed up full outside off and Buttler drives it over extra cover. No chance for long-off
Full around off, he works it to the bowler's right. Rathi chases it into the vacant midwicket area and two more LSG fielders run in, and there's nearly a collision. This allows Buttler to pick up two
Length ball, punched to cover

Buttler punches this in front of point and takes off for a single. Pooran collectes and while rolling on the ground, flicks it towards the striker's end. Pant tries to use his left foot to stop the ball, and amid all that, the batters get the single
Arm ball on a length, tucked to short fine leg
Rising back of a length ball outside off, he punches to mid-off
Slower bouncer outside off and Buttler has swatted that away with remarkable power. Well outside off, but Buttler is up to the task as he pulls this in the gap between deep midwicket and long-on
Hard length on leg stump, Gill stays leg side of the ball and flat-bats to wide long-on
Slower short of a length ball outside off stump, Gill looks to steer that fine but is beatem

Lovely shot and excellent fielding by Markram in the deep. Back of a length ball outside off, Gill brings out his trademark short arm jab swiping him across the line. Markram sprints to his left from deep midwicket and brings out the dive to save two
Back of a length ball outside off stump, Gill lets that go. Called a wide.
Angles the length ball on off stump, Gill punches to extra cover
Three dot balls to end the over. A touch quicker on off stump, Buttler chops this back onto the pitch
And, again. Angled in on middle stump, he ticks this to extra cover again
Tighter lines. Length on off and middle, Buttler can only push to extra cover
Short and wide and punished again. Lots of width outside off as Buttler hops back and slaps this past point
Slower through the air on off, he pushes to long-off

Carved over backward point and despite that not going where he wanted to, Gill gets four. Tossed up outside off, deceives him in the flight. Gill was looking to go inside-out over covers, instead slices over backward point. Gets the desired result even if that was not where he was targeting
Decent over from Rathi. Length ball on off stump, he ticks this to long-on to keep GT going
A touch slower on off and middle, Buttler pushes towards long-on
Pushed quicker on the stumps, he eases to long-on

Dropped by Pant. Rathi gets the ball to fizz through, the ball also turns away from Buttler. He looks to steer this fine, gets a thick outside edge which hits Pant on the right leg. The ball ricochets up but Pant can't locate it and they get a single
Flatter down leg, the ball hits his thigh and rolls to the on-side
Pushed quicker on off stump, he pushes to backward point with an angled bat. Gill wanted a single but is sent back
Tossed up outside off, turning away from Gill, who leans forward and pushes to long-off
Too short, too simple for Gill. Lots of width for Gill, who waits for it and pats in the gap between backward point and short third
Fuller down leg, he works this to deep midwicket
On a length on off and middle stump, Gill prods forward and gets it off the inside half of the bat to the on-side for a quick run
Another shortish delivery outside off, he pats this to deep backward point
Starts off with a short and wide delivery and Buttler cashes in. He waits for it and smashes the cut past backward point

Falls just short of Markram at long-on. Fuller on middle and leg, Buttler clears his front leg and I think he was looking to go straighter. Skews it off the inside half of the bat and luckily for him, the ball doesn't carry

Punched in the gap, punched with disdain. GT's fifty is up in the sixth over. Quicker one from Rathi, was the carrom ball that fizzes back in . But the length is short and Buttler hops back and gets it to the left of mid-off
Fuller on leg stump, he clips to midwicket and another misfield gets them a run
Fuller on off stump, he pushes to extra cover and sets off. A clean pick-up and throw could have made things interesting.
Flatter outside off, he pushes to extra cover

He strikes first ball and signs it in his notebook. Probably one of the worst deliveries that Rathi will ever pick a wicket, but he won't mind. Carrom ball but is a long-hop on leg stump. Sai Sudharsan could have deposited that anywhere, but instead he pulls it straight up with fine leg taking a simple catch

This is just the over GT and Gill were looking for. Twenty off it and GT's chase has picked up pace. Full on middle and leg stump, he flicks this over midwicket and the ball goes for four despite Pooran's sprawling dive.
Oh, what timing and placement from Gill. Short of a good length ball outside off stump, he stands tall and punches through covers for another boundary.

A no-look six from Gill, it's becoming a thing. Length ball on off stump, Gill gets underneath that and with a full flourish of the bat clears mid-on. The ball, in fact, lands full on the boundary cushions
Drifts down leg and those are easy pickings for Gill. Full and down leg, he shuffles across and helps this fine and for four.
Back of a length ball on off stump, he pushes to point
Banged in short on middle and leg, he picks this up to the left of Linde, who hares across from deep backward square leg and saves two with a dive
All class from Sai Sudharsan. Prince angles the length ball across the batter, who waits for it and with an open face of the blade slices him to past backward point
On a length angling back into Gill, he works this past square leg
On a length on off stump, he pushes to covers

Very harsh to all that a drop because Gill had absolutely drilled that back at Prince. Fuller outside off, Gill gets it right off the meat of the blade and smokes it back to Prince, smashing his left thumb. The bowler winces in pain, clutching left hand as the physio runs out again.
Gill shimmies down the track again and stays legside of the ball but Prince follows him and cramps for room. Gill can only push this to mid-off
Fuller on a length around off stump, he punches on the up to the right of mid-off. The ball was flying as Markram dives and half-stops it.
Sharp back of a length ball on middle stump, Sai Sudharsan is cramped for room as he plays the pull. He gets is as far as square leg
Banged in short angling away from BSS outside off, he sways outside the line of that
Back of a length ball just around off stump, he flat-bats this but only as far as mid-on

Driven aerially again but over point. Short of a good length ball shaping away from Gill who pushes away from his body and isn't in control of that drive. Gets enough timing and power, though to get it over the fielder
On a length just outside off stump, Gill pushes to backward point on the move and sets off, but Sai Sudharsan sends him back
Fuller on middle and leg, he pushes to mid-on

Almost pops a catch to mid-on. Hard length on middle stump, BSS wanted to work that away but the ball sticks into the surface and gets a bit big on him. He chips it feebly but the ball falls well short of Rathi at mid-on
Back of a length ball on leg stump, he pulls to the right of deep backward square leg for a run
Flicked away nonchalantly and Gill has his first four of the evening. Length ball down leg and Gill doesn't need any second invitations there as he clips this aerially through square leg
Angles the length ball across Sai Sudharsan just outside off, he pats this past point with an open face of the blade
Jumps down the track to the length ball outside off stump, he can only toe-end it to mid-off for a run
Uppish but safe and Gill is away with two. Length ball angling back into Gill, he works this aerially closer to Rathi at mid-on than what he would have liked. Fortunately for Gill, he finds the gap
SMOKED! Too full outside off stump, was the slower ball but Shami lost his radar there. Sai Sudharsan stretches forward and absolutely laces a cover drive with authority.
Can't split the gap again, but that is largely because of some solid work by Pooran at backward point. Full outside off, he squeezes this to the left of Pooran, who dives and saves four
